pages.text: Animania replaces the farm animals. Cows, pigs, sheep, goats, chickens, rabbits, horses, ferrets, hamsters, cats and more come in real breeds with males, females and young.$(br2)They are not vending machines. An animal that is fed and watered produces; one that is not, does not.
Fill a trough with food (wheat, hay, seeds by animal) or water (bucket). Animals eat and drink on their own. One of each per pen.
Salt licks keep livestock healthy; nests collect the eggs.

$(bold)Milk$() needs a fed, watered cow or goat and a bucket; cheese comes from milk in a cheese mold. $(bold)Wool$() and $(bold)eggs$() come on their own schedule.$(br2)$(bold)Breeding$() needs a male and a female of the same kind, both fed. Young take time to grow.

$(bold)Cats$() hunt rodents and keep ferrets company; $(bold)ferrets$() and $(bold)hamsters$() are pets. $(bold)Draft horses$() pull wagons (see $(l:patchouli:build/wagons)Wagons$()).$(br2)Wild animals are Naturalist's: deer, boar, bears, big cats, snakes. Bears defend themselves; snakes bite; vultures circle. Hunt deer and boar for meat.
A Holstein: the dairy breed. Every breed has a look and a temper; the field manual in your inventory (Animania's) lists them.
